about.title: About NovaStore
about.content: NovaStore is an enterprise-grade retail and distribution platform engineered for product authenticity, transparent multi-warehouse inventory, and reliable nationwide fulfillment.

contact.title: Contact & Corporate Support
contact.content: Our customer operations team is available Monday through Saturday to assist with order inquiries, corporate procurement, and warranty claims.

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery SLA
shipping.content: Orders are dispatched from the nearest regional warehouse within 24 hours of confirmation. Complimentary standard shipping is applied to orders above 500,000 VND.

returns.title: Returns & Refund Policy
returns.content: Eligible items may be returned or exchanged within 30 days of delivery in their original packaging with full accessories and invoice documentation.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.content: Find answers regarding real-time warehouse stock selection, payment settlement methods, and order tracking.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Protection
privacy.content: Customer personal and transactional data is encrypted and processed strictly for order fulfillment and authorized account services.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.content: These terms govern access to the NovaStore platform, product purchases, warranty coverage, and fulfillment obligations.
